thread:
tim_parks: quick sync — we need a crisp partner SEV path for the CloudNexus marketplace launch next week. thinking a lightweight "tiger team" flow rather than full war room for first 72h. thoughts? :eyes:

maria_k: +1 to tiger team. goal should be one shared channel for triage + a short list of who owns which escalation step. avoid duplicating bridges.

alex_chen: recommended channel name: `#partner-sentinel-cloudnexus` — pinned runbook and single bridge when we escalate to S3. keeps it discoverable in search.

chris_sre: prefer `sentinel` vs `warroom` language for partners — less scary and matches our gradated escalation. also: add SRE runbook snippet in the channel with quick commands.

jen_support: can we include a small checklist in the channel header: 1) collect partner request id 2) assign tiger lead 3) call partner POC 4) escalate to oncall if >30m P0? keeps first touch consistent.

leo_partner_eng: fyi CloudNexus prefers a single point of contact and wants their SI in the loop. we should add their integration PM to the channel and use explicit roles: partner_poc, partner_engineer, vendor_sme.

chris_sre: proposed escalation steps (short):
```
P3/P2: handle in channel, notify partner_poc, resolve within business day
P1 (service degradation): tiger team in channel + SRE triage, 30m ack target
P0 (outage): escalate to dedicated bridge, PD page to SRE+Partner oncall, exec notify if >60m
```

tim_parks: love that. for PD paging — do we route straight to partner oncall or go through our liaison first?

jen_support: liaison-first for initial 2-hours, then auto-forward to partner oncall if unresolved. minimizes cross-noise for simple ops.

alex_chen: tech note: we should provision a short-lived shared AWS role for CloudNexus SIs — minimal perms — and link to it in the runbook. reduce repeated credential handoffs.

leo_partner_eng: CloudNexus agrees to the shared role model. will DM creds owner and prep a token rotation schedule.

chris_sre: channel artifacts to pin: runbook, PD escalation playbook (text snippet), shared creds link (vault), and a short postmortem template. example PD message: `PD: P0 CloudNexus - latency spike - svc/ingress - link-> <https://incident/1234>`

oncall-bot: automatic reminders enabled: 30m ack check, 2h liaison check-in, 24h status summary. use `/oncall escalate` to trigger PD.

maria_k: ops checklist for launch day: 1) create `#partner-sentinel-cloudnexus` 2) invite partner_poc and SI lead 3) pin artifacts 4) schedule daily 15m stand at 10:00/16:00 for first 72h 5) scribble quick rollback plan for known blockers. I'll own this.

tim_parks: thanks — maria please create channel and post runbook. alex/ chris — can you add the SRE PD snippet + commands? leo — add partner SI contacts. jen — prep the liaison rotation. I'll draft a one-paragraph comms note for execs if anything hits P0. :thumbsup:

alex_chen: will add PD snippet and `kubectl`/`curl` quickchecks.

chris_sre: added SRE checklist to draft runbook: `check kv cache`, `check loadbalancer`, `tail app logs -n cloudnexus`.

leo_partner_eng: invited CloudNexus PM and SI lead to the channel. they acknowledged and asked for a dry-run of the PD flow later today.

jen_support: liaison rota posted — maria, jen, tim for first 36h then rotate to support oncall.

maria_k: channel created and pinned runbook + links. doing dry-run at 15:30 PT. invite open to anyone who wants to watch.

tim_parks: perfect. dry-run attendees pls drop a :eyes: if you can make 15:30. we'll capture feedback and lock the flow.

alex_chen: :eyes: I'll be there and will simulate PD message so we can validate paging.

jen_support: :eyes:

chris_sre: :eyes:

leo_partner_eng: CloudNexus SI will join the dry-run.

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: dry-run 15:30 PT.

maria_k: thanks everyone — closing thread, will post a short summary after dry-run.
